WITH container_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        c.containregistry,
        c.volliters,
        cd.vialtally,
        s.tempdevcount,
        s.critevents,
        s.tempstabidx,
        c.coolremainpct,
        c.refilllatest,
        -- SER
        (CAST(cd.vialtally AS numeric) * 10) / CAST(c.volliters AS numeric) AS ser,
        -- TSS
        (1 - CAST(s.tempdevcount AS numeric) / 100) * (1 - CAST(s.critevents AS numeric) / 10) * s.tempstabidx AS tss
    FROM container c
    JOIN vaccinedetails cd ON c.containregistry = cd.containvac
    JOIN sensordata s ON c.containregistry = s.containlink
),

    SELECT *,
        CASE 
            WHEN CURRENT_DATE - refilllatest > 0 
            THEN (100 - coolremainpct) / (CURRENT_DATE - refilllatest)::numeric
            ELSE 0
        END AS cdr
    FROM container_metrics
),
with_cri AS (
    SELECT *,
        (1 - tss) * (1 - coolremainpct / 100) AS cri
    FROM with_cdr
),
with_cei AS (
    SELECT *,
        tss * (coolremainpct / 100) * (1 - cdr / 20) AS cei
    FROM with_cri
),
with_ces AS (
    SELECT *,
        ser * cei * (1 - cri) AS ces
    FROM with_cei
)
SELECT 
    containregistry AS container_id,
    ROUND(CAST(ser AS numeric), 4) AS efficiency_score,
    ROUND(CAST(tss AS numeric), 4) AS temperature_stability,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ser DESC) AS rank
FROM with_ces
